h1: Our Vehicle — 2026 Chevrolet Suburban RST | Onyx Executive Miami
a1: A single, immaculately maintained 2026 Chevrolet Suburban RST — the vehicle behind every Onyx Executive Miami trip. Seating, amenities, and what to expect on board.
l5: Why only one vehicle instead of a larger fleet?
l6: One vehicle, maintained to a single standard, means you know exactly what's arriving before it does. As Onyx grows to a small network, every added vehicle is held to the same standard rather than rotated through a rental pool.
l7: Is the vehicle cleaned between every trip?
l8: Yes. Interior and exterior are checked and cleaned between trips, not on a fixed schedule that could leave it presentable-but-not-immaculate for a same-day back-to-back booking.
l9: Can the Suburban fit golf clubs, strollers, or oversized luggage?
l10: Usually, yes — capacity depends on passenger count alongside bag count and size. Tell us what you're bringing at booking and we'll confirm it fits before you arrive, not after.
l11: What happens if the vehicle needs unexpected maintenance?
l12: Maintenance is scheduled around bookings, not the other way around, and the network of vetted partner vehicles covers the rare case of an unplanned issue so a booking is never simply cancelled.
l13: Are child seats included, or do I need to bring my own?
l14: Child seats are arranged in advance once you tell us ages at booking — you don't need to bring your own unless you specifically prefer to.
